'''2019 Worlds Day 3 Steve Baroni LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2019 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Baroni]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open TRM Baroni LS 2019 Worlds.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127130309/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-worlds/ Internet Archive]
